slice_contract.real_problem: determine whether current canonical failure facts expose a measured recovery loss that one new crates/app Host failure-to-action controller can safely fix
acceptance: use only stable canonical failure facts
make no additional model classification request
delete any generic recovery branch that the candidate replaces
existing_owners_must_remain: crates/tools failure causality and side-effect truth
crates/runtime verifier transition, retry, budget and replay policy
slice_contract.cutover_on_no_delta: create no production branch and retain the existing owner-specific recovery mechanisms

failure_matrix.current_owner: ContextBroker plus model-selected canonical search/read tools
failure_matrix.current_behavior: no Host classifier; the M10-B budgeted Working-Set substitute was rejected and deleted
failure_matrix.reason: task difficulty, missing context and model search quality cannot be inferred from a stable current failure code

failure_matrix.canonical_fact: allowed-path and workspace authority violations may surface as workspace_precondition; a semantically wrong but permitted file is detected only by TaskContract/verifier evidence
failure_matrix.current_owner: crates/tools path authority plus TaskContract/EvidenceReceipt completion gate
failure_matrix.current_behavior: reject forbidden scope before mutation; allowed but wrong changes cannot be generically rolled back without risking user work
failure_matrix.reason: workspace_precondition is broader than wrong-file selection and does not authorize a generic rollback

failure_matrix.current_behavior: project the exact failure once, require an effective revision mutation, reject repeated verification of unchanged content, then seal failure-write-pass evidence

failure_matrix.canonical_fact: stale_read, ambiguous_edit, workspace_precondition and patch_parse with typed retry disposition
failure_matrix.current_behavior: fresh read and atomicity checks prevent unsafe mutation; model receives the stable reread/correction action; unsafe side effects are never replayed
failure_matrix.reason: only the model/task context can construct the corrected edit; Host can prove freshness but cannot invent replacement intent

failure_matrix.canonical_fact: malformed_arguments, schema_validation, missing_field, invalid_field and patch_parse
failure_matrix.current_behavior: reject before execution, redact raw malformed bytes, request corrected arguments, bound repeated identical failure by the reserved terminal request

failure_matrix.current_owner: crates/app fixed actor route policy only when a real completion rejection or prior child failure exists
failure_matrix.current_behavior: root/child continuation or recheck uses Pro/max only from typed recovery facts
failure_matrix.reason: model self-assessment, keywords or repeated calls are not a stable causal failure fact

failure_matrix.canonical_fact: ModelAttemptFailure plus exact ModelResponseEvidence and ModelRetryDecision
failure_matrix.current_behavior: retry only when there is no actionable output and replay is proven safe; commit retry atomically and resume it exactly once after crash

failure_matrix.current_owner: crates/deepseek accounting plus corrected eval Harness
failure_matrix.current_behavior: seal the attempt and stop a formal campaign; do not blindly resend
failure_matrix.reason: M9-E proved the official contract cannot reconcile the pre-header attempt per request

failure_matrix.canonical_fact: typed RuntimeFailure budget variants and sealed request accounting
failure_matrix.current_behavior: terminal incomplete/failed; never claim completion and never create capacity outside the frozen budget

failure_matrix.current_owner: tool-specific OperationFailed or Runtime Model/Store failure without a general causal environment profile
failure_matrix.current_behavior: fail with the exact current owner; no generic product-code mutation
failure_matrix.reason: a deterministic ProjectEnvironmentProfile is required before Host can distinguish missing tool, wrong command, service startup and product-code failure

raw.observer_correction: the one frozen false-success label is an evaluator false positive; canonical Host failed-write-pass receipt and external verifier passed

raw.quality_veto: the workspace_precondition arm passed its file verifier and Host receipt but violated the frozen child-call argument contract; this is not a missing recovery action

decision_rule.reason: every safely actionable typed class is already handled by its canonical owner; the remaining requested classes are untyped, safety terminals or depend on M10-E environment facts
decision_rule.forbidden_result: do not create a second app controller that duplicates protocol feedback, Runtime retry or completion authority
decision_rule.next_slice: M10-E Reproducible Environment plus Runtime Artifact Verification

non_conclusions: does not claim that recovery can never improve
does not claim that every model failure is correctly diagnosed
does not admit automatic rollback, a classifier request or a second controller loop
does not change fixed actor routing or the billing_unknown stop rule
does not use historical mechanism evidence as a live product comparison
